remarks: This charming Cotswold home is located in the most coveted neighborhood in Cos Cob, with easy access to schools, trains, shops, dining, and the library. The main floor includes a cozy living room with a fireplace, a powder room, and adjacent sunroom/ office. The bright dining room leads to an eat-in kitchen connected to the family room with views of the patio and terraced gardens. The spacious primary bedroom features an en-suite bath and walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms share a full bath, while the third-floor bedroom offers a walk-in storage closet and window nook.    The finished lower level adds 373 square feet of versatile space, perfect for a gym, office, or playroom, and includes a full bath. This home offers comfortable and convenient lifestyle in a prime location.
